messages:
lena: Heads-up: devexp sampleapp cutover tomorrow AM. Need final ownership and changelog cutoff by EOD. Quick checklist: SDK tag, docs smoke, sampleapp CI green, e2e smoke, changelog entry. Who's owning which?

sam: I can own SDK tag + bump. PR #4821 is open, will finish by 3pm PT. @maya want docs smoke?

maya: Yep, taking docs smoke & quickstart verification. I'll run smoke tests on staging and post results here.

chris: I'll own sampleapp CI fixes — saw a flaky test in tests/auth_spec.rb. Will triage and drop a patch if needed.

maya: Quick note: sampleapp pins an older base image. I can send a tiny patch to update the container if @alex confirms the canary image.

alex: ACK. Use: `gcr.redwood-inference/devexp/sampleapp:canary-20240212` if you need to pull locally. `docker pull gcr.redwood-inference/devexp/sampleapp:canary-20240212`

sam: Changelog cutoff: I'll assemble entries. Please drop a one-line bullet by 5pm PT. Format: `- [component] short fix or feature (PR#)` Example: `- [sdk-go] fix typos in options parsing (PR #4821)`

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: devexp-canary -> staging at 2024-02-13T09:00:00Z. CI required: all checks pass.

chris: :thumbsup: I'll re-run the failing job now and requeue if flakes persist. If CI isn't green by 8:30pm PT we'll roll back that test fix.

maya: Docs smoke green. Quickstart "hello world" ran end-to-end with the canary image. Summary: all steps succeeded, one minor warning on the readme console output. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/devexp-smoke-20240212

sam: SDK tag done: v0.9.3-canary. PR merged and tag pushed. Changelog draft pushed to docs/changelogs/devexp-2024-02-13.md — please add bullets.

lena: Awesome. Final ownership: SDK tagging = Sam, Docs smoke = Maya, SampleApp CI = Chris, Changelog assembly = Sam. If no objections we'll cut the canary at 09:00Z tomorrow. :rocket:

chris: No objections. I'll monitor post-cutover metrics and alert if sample endpoints latency > 120ms.

lena: Thanks all — @everyone please add your changelog bullet if you haven't. I'll close this thread after deploy success.
